run_evaluation_h36m: run evaluation of a trained HMR model on the Human3.6M dataset and compute MPJPE metrics
run_evaluation_3dpw: run evaluation of a trained HMR model on the 3DPW dataset and compute reconstruction error
eval_main_checkpoint: evaluate a model checkpoint across multiple datasets and save results to a JSON log file
run_evaluation_save_results: run evaluation and save predicted joints, pose, betas, and camera parameters to an npz file
eval_main_all_datasets: run evaluation on all supported datasets including h36m-p1, h36m-p2, 3dpw, and mpi-inf-3dhp
